title: Quarterly engineering review slide: regional latency & throughput
what: asia-pacific Q1-to-Q4 p95 latency reduction (% or ms), Q4 p95 latency, or throughput gain (%)

reader_questions.question: How much did asia-pacific p95 latency improve from Q1 to Q4?
reader_questions.expected: Dropped 38.2% (119 ms, from 312.4 ms to 193.2 ms).

reader_questions.question: Is the asia-pacific drop larger than quarter-to-quarter s.d.?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; the 119 ms drop is far larger than the ±13.3/8.1 ms s.d.

reader_questions.question: What happened to asia-pacific throughput, and which region still has the highest p95 latency in Q4?
reader_questions.expected: asia-pacific throughput rose +43.7% (18.6 to 26.8 krps); south-america now has the highest Q4 latency.
